subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in persistent `tui.deliver` config default for TUI launch delivery behavior?
rationale: The missing capability is clear, but root policy sets a high bar for new config/default surfaces and delivery affects more than presentation, so automation should not choose the permanent product contract alone.

options.title: Approve narrow `tui.deliver` config
options.body: Add an optional boolean config default with explicit CLI override precedence, schema/help/docs coverage, and tests for config default plus flag override behavior.

options.title: Keep delivery launch-only
options.body: Close or defer the config request and keep `openclaw tui --deliver` as the explicit opt-in path documented for external delivery.

options.title: Design session preference instead
options.body: Defer this issue into a broader TUI/session-preferences design if maintainers want persistent UI state without another top-level config default.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow `tui.deliver` config
recommendation.body: Add an optional boolean config default with explicit CLI override precedence, schema/help/docs coverage, and tests for config default plus flag override behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and recently maintained the central TUI/config/docs surface affected by the requested product contract.
